suggestions.expectation: session-file.md has Outcome and Open at end written (no _(fill in)_ on either line) and its Narrative mentions this closing
suggestions.reason: Passes on any plausible prose. In this run the executor filled Outcome with a review of docs it never opened (CONTEXT.md, PLAN/ADRs/analyses), inferred from the Goal line. Either seed the fixture conversation with concrete work (a commit or two and a stated finding) so the Outcome can be checked against it, or add an expectation that every doc/file the Outcome names was actually read or changed in transcript.md.

suggestions.expectation: git-state.txt shows `bun run session -- --check` printing session: complete and an empty git status --short
suggestions.reason: The run captured `--check --session SES-006`, which the expectation text does not literally name; the grader had to re-run the bare form to confirm. Either accept the --session form explicitly or require the bare command, since with SES-005 carrying placeholders the two could diverge in another fixture.

No expectation checks that the closing commit is recorded in the session's '## Changes' section (it is empty here) or that exceptions the skill says to name — the non-GitHub origin / skipped PR check — reach reply.md rather than only the transcript. The expected_output says 'every exception named'; the reply names none.

eval_feedback.overall: All six expectations pass on verifiable repo state (clean tree, one well-scoped commit, SES-005 untouched, no outward git actions). The weak spot is content honesty: the Outcome/reply describe a docs review the transcript does not evidence, and no expectation would catch that.
